meetings.body: Maui MPO Policy Board Adopts New Logo & Finalizes Reconciliation
meetings.headline: Maui MPO Policy Board Adopts New Logo & Finalizes Reconciliation
meetings.summary: The Maui MPO Policy Board heard that staff finished reconciling past finances and adopted a new logo.

meetings.body: Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave, Names Wayne Mikaele Acting Chief
meetings.headline: Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave, Names Wayne Mikaele Acting Chief
meetings.summary: The commission placed Chief John Pelletier on paid administrative leave during its investigation and named the deputy chief as acting chief.

meetings.headline: Commission picks top-ranked finalist as new DPS director
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to appoint its top-ranked finalist as DPS director, with the offer pending a background check.

meetings.headline: Budget & Finance COG
meetings.summary: The Cost of Government Commission heard from county technology and council staff on cybersecurity and AI, and approved its minutes.

meetings.body: Maui Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave
meetings.headline: Maui Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave
meetings.summary: The Maui Police Commission voted to place the police chief on paid leave and made the deputy chief acting chief.

meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission approved minutes, deferred the director selection, and recessed until October 8 at 3 p.m.

meetings.headline: Lahaina Rebuild Design Review
meetings.summary: The board approved a new home at 1191 Front Street and deferred review of a Lahaina fire rebuild at 1429 Front Street.

meetings.headline: Maui MPO TAC
meetings.summary: The committee approved September 1 minutes, heard a resident's testimony, and reviewed draft changes to how transportation projects are ranked.

meetings.body: Civil Service Commission Interviews 3 DPS Director Candidates
meetings.headline: Civil Service Commission Interviews 3 DPS Director Candidates
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission interviewed candidates for DPS director and plans to meet October 7 to review them and hopefully decide.

meetings.headline: Commission sets interview plan for new department director
meetings.summary: The Civil Service Commission set interviews for the 30th and voted to invite DPS employees to take part in the selection process.

meetings.body: Board of Variances Reviews Haʻikū Zipline & Lumeria Maui Appeals
meetings.headline: Board of Variances Reviews Haʻikū Zipline & Lumeria Maui Appeals
meetings.summary: The board continued a zipline appeal to January 28th and an MRC Partners LLC appeal to December 10th.

meetings.body: Maui Boards & Commissions Reviews Vacancies and 2027 Nominations
meetings.headline: Maui Boards & Commissions Reviews Vacancies and 2027 Nominations
meetings.summary: The Independent Nomination Board interviewed applicants in a closed session and set November 11th as the application deadline for 2027 mass nominations.

meetings.headline: Planning Commission splits recommendations on hotel rezoning bills
meetings.summary: Planning Commission splits recommendations on hotel rezoning bills.

meetings.body: Maui Liquor Control Commission Launches Director Search
meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Control Commission Launches Director Search
meetings.summary: The Liquor Control Commission voted to use an open application process and create a small group to hire a search firm for a new director.

meetings.headline: Commission seeks list of county-funded youth programs
meetings.summary: The commission approved its minutes and voted to request a list of county-funded youth programs, aiming to build awareness of available resources.

meetings.headline: Aha Moku o Maui Hikina
meetings.summary: BLNR rejected the operator's request for a contested case (a trial-like hearing) after an executive session (a closed-door discussion).

meetings.headline: Maui Fire & Public Safety Commission
meetings.summary: The Fire and Public Safety Commission approved its fiscal year 2026 annual report and heard emergency management, fire department and fire shop updates.

meetings.body: Board of Water Supply Rejects Bill 1 CD1, Reviews West Maui Wells
meetings.headline: Board of Water Supply Rejects Bill 1 CD1, Reviews West Maui Wells
meetings.summary: The Board of Water Supply voted not to support Bill 1 and heard a timeline for new West Maui wells.

meetings.headline: Maui Ferry Program
meetings.summary: The county plans to keep Lānaʻi ferry service and expand to Molokaʻi, hoped for by early 2029, with a private company running it.

meetings.headline: Lānaʻi commission backs farm subdivision notice bill on second vote
meetings.summary: The commission approved a farm subdivision notice bill on a second vote and reviewed a permit for a private Four Seasons event.

meetings.headline: Board of Variances and Appeals
meetings.summary: The board adopted an amended decision to settle a court appeal over a vacation rental and approved its meeting calendar.

meetings.headline: Commission on Persons with Disabilities
meetings.summary: The commission heard an ethics briefing, voted to create an accessibility concern tracker, and will put a post-hurricane review on its next agenda.

meetings.headline: Maui Liquor Commission
meetings.summary: Liquor commissioners accepted a brewery's application despite zoning questions, renewed a wildfire emergency rule, and heard the director will retire December 31.

meetings.headline: Banyan supports added; Kula burn scar fencing and replanting update
meetings.summary: The Arborist Committee heard a banyan tree update, planned exceptional tree measurements, and heard about fencing and replanting in the Kula burn scar.

meetings.headline: Independent Nomination Board
meetings.summary: The board formed one TIG to interview applicants and, after closed-door interviews, voted to send names to several boards.

meetings.body: Who Really Owns East Maui's Water System?
meetings.headline: Who Really Owns East Maui's Water System?
meetings.summary: A presenter questioned whether a private company truly owns the East Maui ditch system, citing old licenses and state land.
